body:
AUDIT: FAIL
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'sweep-adopt-veridian-scripts-190-chore-scripts-preserve-session-metadata' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed:  session_metadata_sync.py   | 187 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 sweep_awaiting_approval.py | 163 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 350 insertions(+)
Evidence Recorded: session_metadata_sync.py is a benign, additive read-only analysis script and is fine as-is, but sweep_awaiting_approval.py is a serious policy/security regression: its process_task() only checks review.get("verdict") == "approve" before running gh pr merge -- it never inspects the recorded review's tier, so any task sitting in awaiting_human_approval with a stored approve verdict gets merged autonomously, including tier2 tasks that reached that status specifically because SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md's tiered trust model requires human sign-off before merge for tier2 (schema/auth/security-sensitive changes). The script's own docstring justifies this blanket retroactive auto-merge by citing an unverified "Owner directive... AGENTS.md Rule 12... claude-control PR #118... Owner's full-approval directive" -- this is exactly the recurring false-premise pattern seen across prior veridian-scripts tasks (confident claims of directives/root-causes that don't match live state) and there is no evidence in this diff that the cited directive was actually verified. Landing this script in the repo makes a tier2-bypass merge tool available for future invocation even though adding the file itself is a low-blast-radius (tier1) diff. Issues found: sweep_awaiting_approval.py never checks review.json's "tier" field before calling gh pr merge -- it will autonomously merge tier2-held PRs (schema/auth/security/payment-pattern changes) that were explicitly routed to awaiting_human_approval for human sign-off, directly violating the tier2 hard-hold rule in SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md; The script's justification rests on an unverified claimed "Owner directive" (AGENTS.md Rule 12 / claude-control PR #118) -- matches the known recurring false-premise pattern in this repo's task specs; should be independently verified before this script is ever run, and the diff gives no evidence that verification happened; load_controller_tasks() reads CONTROLLER.yaml directly via yaml.safe_load, bypassing the file-locking mechanism documented as added for concurrent-writer safety, risking a race with an in-flight writer during the sweep; gh pr merge is invoked without --delete-branch, deviating from the tier1 merge pattern (`gh pr merge --merge --delete-branch`) documented elsewhere in the standing instructions
Severity Classified: medium
Verdict: fail
Corrective Action Owner: Worker to address the findings listed above and resubmit.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Required after corrective changes are pushed.
